title: resources.jsonc
description: What a worker earns at a deposit or a Generator, how many workers one of them takes, and the worker itself (game design 4.1). Whole numbers are bare; a number with a fraction is text, such as "0.5".

materials.description: Materials, earned by workers at deposits.

per_worker_per_minute.description: What one worker earns in a minute, before the Extraction multiplier.

workers_per_deposit.description: The worker places of one deposit.

full_rate_amount.description: The Materials a deposit delivers at the whole rate, Extraction bonus included.

depleted_rate.description: The share of the rate a deposit pays after that: above 0 and at most 1.

energy.description: Energy, earned by workers at Generators.

per_worker_per_minute.description: What one worker earns in a minute, before the Extraction multiplier.

workers_per_generator.description: The worker places of one Generator.

worker.description: The one worker type. Its speed, sight, supply and price are the same at every tier.

spacing.description: Least distance between unit centers at rest, in tiles.

build_seconds.description: Build time in seconds. It must be a whole number of ticks.

number.description: A whole number, or text in plain decimal notation such as "2.6". A bare number with a fraction is not accepted, so that every value is read exactly.
